name: RES Multistep Ancestral CFG++
plain: Combines the CFG++ path and ancestral noise of res_multistep with η=1 default. cfg=1 shortcut off, no flow branch.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
t=−log σ, φ₁(z)=(e^z−1)/z, φ₂(z)=(φ₁(z)−1)/z. t_d=−log σ_down, h=t_d−t, c₂=(t_{i−1}−t_old)/h where t_old=−log(previous σ_down). b₁=φ₁(−h)−φ₂(−h)/c₂, b₂=φ₂(−h)/c₂ (NaN→0).
get_ancestral_step: σ_up=min(σ', η·√(σ'²(σ²−σ'²)/σ²)); σ_down=√(σ'²−σ_up²); η=0 returns (σ', 0).
First step or σ_down=0: x'=D+σ_down(x−U)/σ. Otherwise x_s=x+(D−U); x'=e^{−h}x_s+h(b₁U+b₂U_old). If σ_up>0: x'+=n·s_noise·σ_up.

props.prediction_space: x0 in −log σ, from U, VE renoise
props.flow_const: No CONST branch, no RF dispatch.
